svg.title: Amberly Home Atelier pantry organization portfolio concept
svg.desc: Fictional home organization portfolio concept for Amberly Home Atelier, showing an organized pantry with clear bins and woven baskets. Purpose-built demonstration visual for LocalPro Directory; it does not depict a real business, credential, review or completed client project.
